what: The concept: what a flow diagram claims
title: Money-flow diagrams from PEIMS finance data
text: Sankey-style chart makes two kinds statements. Node sizes say “much money category” – ordinary totals, PEIMS supports richly, every row carries full chart accounts: source class – local (object 5700s), state (5800s), federal (5900s) revenue; fund – account money sits (general fund, food service, Title , debt service, …); function – spending (instruction, school leadership, …); object – bought (payroll, contracted services, supplies, capital outlay, …); program intent – intended serve (basic services, special education, …). Ribbons, though, say something stronger: “money became money.” claim honest accounting actually records join. Money fungible – TEA record revenue dollar paid invoice – ribbon drawn straight “State revenue” “Instruction” invention. recorded, sides, fund. revenue row says fund dollar entered; expenditure row says fund left, along function, object, program intent. Funds also legally meaningful: grant funds restricted, federal dollar arriving Title fund can leave Title spending. makes source -> fund -> function chain genuine recorded totals, txs_peims_flow() refuses put "source" next anything "fund". Two wrinkles remain. First, money also enters leaves funds outside ordinary revenue spending: PEIMS records inter-fund transfers (objects 7915 , 8911 ) financing sources uses (bond, loan, lease proceeds, asset sales; remaining 7900s/8900s). flow builder draws nodes – transfers half-edges via “Transfers /funds”, TEA records end fund fund--fund pairing. Second, funds rarely break even year: district draws bond proceeds banked earlier, tucks away surplus. left revenues, spending, transfers, financing fund’s true change pot, reconciled explicit “fund balance” “fund balance” nodes – sides every fund sum identically chart accounts every dollar.

title: Polite, Reproducible Access to Texas Education Agency Public Performance Data
text: txschools provides reproducible, polite, -demand access public school-performance data published Texas Education Agency (TEA): TAPR (Texas Academic Performance Reports, 2013-present): per-campus semantic datasets via txs_get_tapr(), statewide data files via txs_get_tapr_file(), variable dictionary via txs_get_tapr_dictionary(). SRC (School Report Card, 2004-2019): per-campus reports via txs_get_src() – parsed tidy data 2004-2012 HTML era, cached PDFs 2013-2019. (2020+ SRC lives txschools.gov, package scrape.) AEIS (Academic Excellence Indicator System, 2004-2012): statewide data files via txs_get_aeis(). PEIMS financial data (1999-2000-present): statewide fund/function/object-level district charter budgets actuals via txs_get_peims_finance(), optional DuckDB output via txs_write_peims_db(). Every table functions return documented machine-readable data dictionary – column types, ranges, masking semantics, relationships, glossary TEA terms – data-dict.yaml format, shipped package:
code: system.file("data-dict.yaml", package = "txschools")

text: Available axes, canonical order: "source" – revenue class object code: local (5700s), state (5800s), federal (5900s). "fund" – TEA fund (general fund, food service, Title , ...). "function" – spending (instruction, ...). "object" – bought: payroll (6100s), contracted services (6200s), supplies (6300s), operating (6400s), debt service (6500s), capital outlay (6600s). "program" – program intent (basic, special education, ...). Every edge genuine total data: revenue rows record (source, fund) jointly, expenditure rows record (fund, function, object, program) jointly. TEA record revenue dollar paid bill, "source" may followed "fund" (money traceable source--spending fund); requesting e.g. c("source", "function") errors.

PEIMS records end fund fund--fund pairing, transfers drawn half-edges nodes rather invented fund--fund ribbons; financing sources uses (remaining 7900s/8900s: bond, loan, lease proceeds, asset sales, ...) enter "financing sources" node leave "financing uses" node; remains genuine change fund's pot: fund's shortfall fed "fund balance" node fund's surplus drains "fund balance" node, sides every fund reconcile exactly.
